title: Mussoorie & Mall Road Travel Guide - The Queen of Hills
content:
Mussoorie Mall Road,

Mussoorie, also called the “Queen of Hills”, is one of the most loved hill stations in North India. Located in Uttarakhand, just 35 km from Dehradun and 285 km from Delhi, Mussoorie sits at an altitude of 2,000 meters (6,600 ft). From here, you get clear views of the Himalayan peaks on one side and the Doon Valley on the other.

Mussoorie became popular during the British colonial period, when officers and families came here to escape the summer heat. Even today, it is a favorite spot for honeymooners, families, and weekend travelers.

At the heart of the hill station is the lively Mall Road, which stretches for about 2 km. This road is the social hub of Mussoorie, packed with cafes, shops, restaurants, handicraft stalls, old-style buildings, and street food vendors. In the evening, Mall Road comes alive with lights, music, and the buzz of tourists enjoying the cool mountain air.

What makes Mussoorie unique is that it offers something for everyone – shopping on Mall Road, peaceful walks on Camel’s Back Road, waterfalls like Kempty and Jharipani, viewpoints like Gun Hill and Lal Tibba, and adventure activities like trekking and paragliding.

Best Time to Visit Mussoorie:

  • Peak Season (March - June): Pleasant and cool weather, 15°C – 25°C. Perfect for sightseeing, shopping, and outdoor fun. Expect large crowds during summer holidays.
  • Moderate Season (September - November): Clear skies, 10°C – 20°C. Best for photography, long walks, and enjoying the misty hills.
  • Low Season (December - February): Cold winter, 2°C – 10°C. If you love snow, this is the time to visit. Hotels are cheaper, but carry heavy woolens.
  • Monsoon (July - August): 15°C – 22°C with heavy rains. Hills turn lush green, but there’s a risk of landslides and slippery roads.

(If you want to enjoy snowfall, come in late December or January. For families, March to June is the most comfortable time.)

Things to Do in Mussoorie & Mall Road:

  • Stroll Along Mall Road – The most famous activity in Mussoorie. Shop for woolens, handicrafts, wooden toys, and souvenirs.
  • Try Local Food – Hot Maggi, momos, Tibetan noodles, and pastries at colonial-style cafes. Don’t miss hot chocolate in the winter.
  • Gun Hill Point – Reach by ropeway or trek for a panoramic view of the Himalayas and Doon Valley.
  • Kempty Falls – The most visited waterfall near Mussoorie, perfect for families.
  • Camel’s Back Road – A peaceful walking route with views of the sunset and a natural rock shaped like a camel’s hump.
  • Lal Tibba – The highest point in Mussoorie, offering telescope views of snow peaks.
  • Christ Church – A historic church built in 1836, one of the oldest in the Himalayas.
  • Company Garden – Beautiful garden with flowers, boating, and rides for children.
  • Mussoorie Lake – A man-made lake with boating and picnic spots.
  • Adventure Sports – Try paragliding, trekking, zip-lining, camping, and roller skating at India’s oldest skating rink.
  • Evening Walks – Mall Road glows at night with lights, music, and the smell of street food.
  • Shopping for Tibetan Goods – Woolen shawls, jewelry, carpets, and handmade crafts.

How to Reach Mussoorie:

  • By Road: Mussoorie is 35 km from Dehradun (1–1.5 hours). Regular buses, shared taxis, and private cabs are available.
  • By Train: Nearest station is Dehradun Railway Station (34 km). From there, take a taxi or bus.
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant Airport (59 km). Cabs are available to Mussoorie.

Best 10 Places to Visit Near Mussoorie (within 50 km):

1- Kempty Falls (15 km): Iconic waterfall, best for families.

2- Jharipani Falls (8 km): Hidden and peaceful waterfall.

3- Mossy Falls (7 km): Natural falls surrounded by greenery.

4- Bhatta Falls (10 km): Clean and less crowded, great for picnics.

5- Lal Tibba (6 km): Mussoorie’s highest viewpoint.

6- George Everest’s House (6 km): Historic house of Sir George Everest with valley views.

7- Cloud’s End (7 km): Forest area with trekking trails.

8- Company Garden (3 km): Colorful garden and boating spot.

9- Nag Tibba Trek (45 km): Popular short trek near Mussoorie.

10- Dhanaulti (25 km): Peaceful hill station with eco-parks and adventure camps.
excerpt: Mussoorie and Mall Road are the soul of hill station tourism in Uttarakhand. From shopping streets and historic churches to waterfalls, viewpoints, and adventure sports, Mussoorie has everything a traveler looks for. Whether you want a family holiday, a honeymoon, or just a weekend escape, Mussoorie is a destination that never disappoints.
